description: 8 base topic-to-topic relation types. Each has an inverse (which may equal itself for symmetric relations). Auto-inference rules describe when the substrate is allowed to propose this relation without user confirmation.

broader_than.label: Broader Than
broader_than.description: Source topic is a more general category that contains the target.
broader_than.auto_inference_rule: If topic A's member set is a SUPERSET of topic B's members (>= 90%), propose A broader_than B at confidence 0.85.

narrower_than.label: Narrower Than
narrower_than.description: Source topic is a more specific case of the target.
narrower_than.auto_inference_rule: Auto-inferred as inverse of broader_than. Direct inference: if B's members are a subset of A's, propose B narrower_than A.

peer_of.label: Peer Of
peer_of.description: Sibling topics at the same conceptual level — different instances of the same parent concept.
peer_of.auto_inference_rule: If two topics share the same broader_than parent, propose peer_of at confidence 0.9.

explains.label: Explains
explains.description: Source topic provides the explanation/cause for the target. Asymmetric.
explains.auto_inference_rule: Not auto-inferred; requires LLM analysis or user assertion. Detected when two topics share members AND one carries assessments with predicates like 'caused', 'explains', 'resulted_from'.

contradicts.label: Contradicts
contradicts.description: Topics with mutually incompatible claims about the same subject matter. Used for framing-level conflict detection that SPO collapse can't catch.
contradicts.auto_inference_rule: If two topics share members AND their respective assessments have opposite polarity on the same edge type for the same node pair, propose contradicts at confidence 0.75.

follows.label: Follows
follows.description: Source topic's temporal_span starts after the target's ends (or overlaps later). Used for causal/temporal chains across topics.
follows.auto_inference_rule: Direct inference from temporal_span — if A.start_time > B.end_time, propose A follows B at confidence 1.0.

references.label: References
references.description: Source topic cites or quotes target without making a stronger claim. Cheapest topic-to-topic edge.
references.auto_inference_rule: If a topic's member documents cite documents that belong to another topic, propose references at confidence 0.7.

same_as.label: Same As (federation merge)
same_as.description: Two topic nodes are the same real-world topic — used during federation to declare canonical equivalence. Different from peer_of which is conceptual sibling.
same_as.auto_inference_rule: If two topics share >95% of members AND have the same temporal_span AND have very-similar labels (LLM-judged), propose same_as at confidence 0.95. User typically confirms before merge.
examples: Node A's 'Roswell Incident' same_as Node B's 'Roswell UFO Event'

content.collapse_relationship: Topic-relation collapse uses the same algebra as assertion collapse — if two sources independently claim A broader_than B, the relations merge (corroboration count++). If sources claim contradictory relations (A broader_than B vs A narrower_than B), a topic_relation_conflict is created.
